pageProps.title: Linux DRM - GEM: handle, dumb buffer, mmap
pageProps.review: Explains Linux DRM GEM's drm_gem_object, per-file handles, dumb buffer creation flow, mmap fake offsets, and page fault handling through kernel source code based on Linux v6.19.
